BiblicalUsage: A single board in Ezekiel's temple vision carries this word, a thin plank cieled with wood round about the door posts and narrow windows. It is the kind of detail only a builder would notice, and Ezekiel records it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a board in the temple matters to God, because He gave the pattern down to the woodwork.
